note: Body-level reference conditions. Values are global reference values, not observations at an analysis site. 'reproducible_in_field' describes whether an open-air terrestrial field site reproduces the condition; it is a design classification by EGIZ, reviewed against the cited sources.

factors.name: Surface gravity
factors.correction_scope: Bekker rigid-wheel sinkage/compaction resistance under declared load protocols only. Gravity-dependent soil strength is not modelled.
lab_alternatives: Mass-matched rather than load-matched wheel testing (Wong 2012)

moon.source: NASA NSSDCA Moon Fact Sheet https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html (1.62 m/s^2, verified 2026-11-13)

mars.source: NASA NSSDCA Mars Fact Sheet, mean surface gravity (sheet updated 19 May 2025) https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/marsfact.html. Note: the existing EGIZ Mission Lab environment uses the older 3.71.

evidence.statement: Proposes Earth testing with identical mass rather than identical normal load to predict extraterrestrial rigid-wheel sinkage and compaction resistance.

Parabolic-flight wheel tests on a Mars simulant reported reduced traction and increased sinkage in reduced gravity relative to 1 g at equal wheel load (as summarised in the session literature search; full text not read).
1/6 g parabolic-flight cone penetration in GRC-1 reported a markedly reduced cone index gradient (reduced shear strength), i.e. soil strength depends on gravity.

factors.name: Atmospheric pressure and composition
factors.correction_scope: Only the attenuation of direct solar irradiance is modelled (Earth clear-sky approximation; Mars Beer-Lambert with declared optical depth). Convection, aeolian transport and thermal coupling are not modelled.

moon.source: NASA NSSDCA Moon Fact Sheet (surface exosphere; effectively vacuum)

mars.source: Order-of-magnitude mean surface pressure (~0.6 kPa, seasonally variable); exact NSSDCA value not verified in this session

factors.name: Ionising radiation environment
lab_alternatives: Separate radiation qualification (NASA_ANALOGS); field ranking does not model radiation

factors.name: Surface thermal environment and diurnal cycle
lab_alternatives: Thermal vacuum chamber with controlled boundary conditions (NASA_TVAC)

earth.source: Site temperatures not acquired (MODIS LST adapter implemented, not run)

moon.source: Target temperatures intentionally blank in EGIZ targets.json

mars.source: Target temperatures intentionally blank in EGIZ targets.json

factors.name: Regolith mechanical properties
factors.correction_scope: No correction: terrestrial field soils are unmeasured. CF_TERRAMECHANICS can only explore declared Bekker parameters, it cannot make a field soil equivalent to regolith.
lab_alternatives: In-situ bevameter testing at the field site (planner measurement M_BEVAMETER)

earth.source: No soil mechanics measured at any EGIZ Earth window

moon.source: Apollo-era design estimates from Surveyor/Apollo data, described by NASA as rough estimates (NASA M2M-30044 Lunar Surface Data Book; NASA TM-20250006958)

mars.source: No Jezero regolith mechanics parameters acquired

factors.name: Dust behaviour (lunar electrostatic charging; Martian aeolian dust)
Volatile behaviour (cold-trapped ice, sublimation)
lab_alternatives: Cryogenic vacuum chamber with icy simulant

factors.name: Direct-to-Earth / relay communication geometry
lab_alternatives: Link emulation with recorded SPICE Earth-elevation series

earth.source: Terrestrial infrastructure; not an analog of planetary link geometry

factors.name: Polar low-Sun illumination regime
factors.correction_scope: Natural Earth windows reproduce low solar elevation for limited hours and seasons; artificial lighting (JETT Sun cart) is an alternative.
